findings.en_sentence: Louis Dollo intended to describe the holotype in 1931 but died before he could publish the description.
findings.es_sentence: Louis Dollo pretendía describir el holotipo en 1931, pero falleció antes de poder publicar la descripción.
findings.problem: 1931 is the year Dollo died, not the year he planned to describe the specimen; the source says he died in 1931 before describing it.
findings.correct: Louis Dollo put the holotype on display and intended to describe it, but he died in 1931 before he could. / Louis Dollo expuso el holotipo y pretendía describirlo, pero murió en 1931 antes de poder hacerlo.
findings.checked_in: F003 quote (enwiki intro, oldid 1314015068); knowledge (Dollo d. 19 Apr 1931)

findings.en_sentence: Recent molecular studies suggest that Tomistominae, including Dollosuchoides, belong to Gavialoidea and Gavialidae rather than being crocodiles.
findings.es_sentence: Estudios moleculares recientes sugieren que la Tomistominae, incluyendo a Dollosuchoides, pertenece a los Gavialoidea y a la familia Gavialidae en lugar de ser un cocodrilo.
findings.problem: 'rather than being crocodiles' is invented (gavialoids are still crocodilians); the DNA studies concern Tomistoma, extended only by inference to extinct tomistomines, and Dollosuchoides itself is not placed in Gavialidae (see next sentence).
findings.correct: DNA studies have consistently found that the false gharial (Tomistoma), and by inference its extinct tomistomine relatives, belong to Gavialoidea (Gavialidae). / Los estudios de ADN indican de forma constante que el falso gavial (Tomistoma) y, por extensión, los tomistominos extintos pertenecen a Gavialoidea (Gavialidae).

findings.en_sentence: Recent molecular studies suggest that Tomistominae, including Dollosuchoides, belong to Gavialoidea and Gavialidae rather than being crocodiles.
findings.es_sentence: Estudios moleculares recientes sugieren que la Tomistominae, incluyendo a Dollosuchoides, pertenece a los Gavialoidea y a la familia Gavialidae en lugar de ser un cocodrilo.
findings.problem: Places Dollosuchoides in Gavialidae, contradicting the following sentence that it is a basal gavialoid outside the gharial + false gharial clade (i.e. outside Gavialidae).
findings.checked_in: F007, F008 (enwiki Phylogeny cladogram, Lee & Yates 2018)

findings.en_sentence: A 2018 study indicates Dollosuchoides is a basal gavialoid, predating the common ancestor of gharials and false gharials.
findings.es_sentence: Un estudio de 2018 indica que Dollosuchoides es un gavialoide basal, anterior al ancestro común de los garias y los falsos garias.
findings.problem: The source says 'more basal than' the last common ancestor (a branching position on the cladogram), not that it lived earlier in time ('predating'/'anterior').
findings.correct: A 2018 study by Lee & Yates recovers Dollosuchoides as a basal gavialoid, outside the group formed by the gharial and the false gharial. / Un estudio de 2018 (Lee y Yates) sitúa a Dollosuchoides como un gavialoide basal, fuera del grupo formado por el gavial y el falso gavial.

findings.en_sentence: A 2018 study indicates Dollosuchoides is a basal gavialoid, predating the common ancestor of gharials and false gharials.
findings.es_sentence: Un estudio de 2018 indica que Dollosuchoides es un gavialoide basal, anterior al ancestro común de los garias y los falsos garias.
findings.problem: 'garias' is a calque of 'gharials'; the Spanish names are 'gavial' and 'falso gavial'.
findings.checked_in: knowledge (Gavialis gangeticus = gavial; Tomistoma schlegelii = falso gavial)

findings.en_sentence: Dollosuchoides is an extinct genus of gavialoid crocodilian known colloquially as the Crocodile of Maransart.
findings.es_sentence: Dollosuchoides es un género extinto de cocodrilomorfo gavialoide, conocido coloquialmente como el cocodrilo de Maransart.
findings.problem: 'crocodilian' (Crocodylia) is rendered as 'cocodrilomorfo' (Crocodylomorpha), a much broader clade.
findings.correct: Dollosuchoides es un género extinto de cocodriliano gavialoide, conocido coloquialmente como el cocodrilo de Maransart.

findings.en_sentence: The holotype specimen IRScNB 482 — the specimen the species is based on — was discovered in 1915 and prepared between 1926 and 1927 by Hubert, Mehschaert, and Jean de Kleermaeker.
findings.es_sentence: El holotipo IRScNB 482 —la muestra sobre la que se basa la especie— fue descubierto en 1915 y preparado entre 1926 y 1927 por Hubert, Mehschaert y Jean de Kleermaeker.
findings.problem: 'muestra' (sample) is the wrong term for a fossil specimen; Spanish uses 'ejemplar'.
findings.correct: ...—el ejemplar en el que se basa la especie—...

findings.en_sentence: The specimen was originally referred to the genus Dollosuchus by Swinton in 1937 before being moved to its own genus by Brochu in 2007.
findings.es_sentence: La muestra fue referida originalmente al género Dollosuchus por Swinton en 1937 antes de ser trasladada a su propio género por Brochu en 2007.
findings.problem: 'muestra' for specimen; 'referida' is a calque of 'referred' (Spanish: 'asignado/atribuido').
findings.correct: Swinton atribuyó el ejemplar al género Dollosuchus en 1937, hasta que Brochu lo trasladó a su propio género en 2007.

findings.en_sentence: Recent molecular studies suggest that Tomistominae, including Dollosuchoides, belong to Gavialoidea and Gavialidae rather than being crocodiles.
findings.es_sentence: Estudios moleculares recientes sugieren que la Tomistominae, incluyendo a Dollosuchoides, pertenece a los Gavialoidea y a la familia Gavialidae en lugar de ser un cocodrilo.
findings.problem: 'la Tomistominae' (feminine singular article on a plural clade name) and singular 'un cocodrilo' after a group subject; gerund 'incluyendo' is an anglicism.
findings.correct: ...que los tomistominos pertenecen a Gavialoidea (familia Gavialidae)...
